ABOUT CALI FRAMES

Hi, I’m Maya

I’m 11 years old and I’m from Oceanside, California. I started Cali Frames because both of my parents work with AI and I wanted to get involved with AI too.

On Cali Frames, you can buy posters — you can even get customized posters — and each one comes with a frame.

If you want a customized poster, tell me all about you: your favorite things, colors, and what you’d love to see. I can use your answers to make a really cool poster just for you.

I hope you have fun shopping on Cali Frames!
